a.lede: The FAA determined that a rogue feature in two newly installed routers are to blame for the communications glitches that caused the nationwide ground stop.
a.title: Two HPE Juniper network routers grounded all US flights on Friday

b.lede: The FAA has also disabled the other 68 routers that had already been installed.
b.title: FAA suspends installation of router that led to a ground stop of flights across the US
